meaning: How often this agent's aura covered this ally when both were alive and had no spawn shield. Checks the start of each tick. Each aura giver is measured separately, even when auras overlap.
missing_when: This measurement was not recorded; or either agent was not included in this game; or this agent is not a Warrior; or the number to divide by (ticks when both the From and To agents were alive without spawn shields, including ticks out of range) is zero.
gui_label: Warrior Aura Coverage
numerator: Ticks this Warrior's aura covered this ally
denominator: Ticks when both the From and To agents were alive without spawn shields, including ticks out of range
gui_groups: Aura Coverage: By Recipient

meaning: How much of this agent's aura coverage went to this ally. Checks the start of each tick. The aura giver and ally must both be alive and have no spawn shield. The aura giver can count as its own ally. The ally must be in aura range. Example: 4 out of 10 gives 0.4, or 40%.
missing_when: This measurement was not recorded; or either agent was not included in this game; or this agent is not a Warrior; or the number to divide by (all this aura giver's covered ally-ticks, where each covered ally on each tick counts once) is zero.
gui_label: Share of This Warrior's Aura Coverage That Went to This Ally
numerator: Ticks this agent's Warrior aura covered this ally
denominator: All this aura giver's covered ally-ticks, where each covered ally on each tick counts once
gui_groups: Aura Coverage: By Recipient

meaning: How often this agent supplied a Warrior aura while this ally was covered by one. Checks the start of each tick. The aura giver and ally must both be alive and have no spawn shield. The aura giver can count as its own ally. The ally must be in aura range. Several auras can cover the ally on the same tick, so their shares can add up to more than 1 (100%).
missing_when: This measurement was not recorded; or either agent was not included in this game; or this agent is not a Warrior; or the number to divide by (ticks at least one Warrior aura from Team B covered this ally) is zero.
